title: Stripe
summary: Reads the Stripe balance, available and pending, and the payouts on their way to the bank from api.stripe.com every hour, into Money's accounts.
changes: When Stripe refuses the key, the script's line names it "Stripe (read only)", the name the key is shown under everywhere else, where it said the bare label "stripe".
author: BrainDog

grant.label: Key
grant.note: The label of the key in the vault the script sends to Stripe. A label and never the key itself: an add-on that carries a key is refused.

book.label: Book
book.note: The number of the book in Books the Stripe accounts are filed in, such as 2. Changing it moves them the next hour. Leave it at 0 to file none.

declarations.title: Stripe balance and payouts
